description: Register a public HTTPS URL to receive batch-completion and deletion events. Each delivery is signed: X-SightRadar-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, '<X-SightRadar-Timestamp>.<raw body>'). If you omit secret one is generated and returned ONCE in this answer: tell the user to store it. Free.

secret.description: Signing secret to use. Omit to have one generated.

url.description: Public https:// URL that will receive POSTs.
